decision: The 2026-08-24 search pass found no single modern-designed source that simultaneously shows a living horse, skull/rib/long-bone barding, coherent tack, one mounted feral warrior, a painted skull helmet, a visible sling, a visible stone pouch, no spear, and four readable horse legs. The asset remains blocked rather than accepting an undead horse, riderless sheet, generic cavalry, spear-bearing substitute, or composite.
